reason: The candidate relationship claims PSENEN "disrupts_pathway" autophagy. However, the quoted sentence and the abstract as a whole do not support this predicate direction. The authors show that PSENEN knockout cells have "alterations in the autophagy-lysosome system" (including reduced lysosomal enzyme activity, reduced lysosome number, increased autophagosomes, etc.), but they explicitly state that PSENEN and CLN3 play "converging roles...in a γ-secretase activity-independent manner, supporting the idea of common cytopathological processes underlying different neurodegenerative diseases." The alterations suggest a regulatory or modulatory role, not a simple disruption. Furthermore, the abstract suggests these are consequences of PSENEN loss rather than PSENEN actively disrupting the pathway. The predicate "disrupts_pathway" is stronger and more directional than what the authors claim. The finding describes what happens when PSENEN is knocked out, not that PSENEN disrupts autophagy under normal conditions.
